title: Build Your Own Tiny World
description: Build Your Own Tiny World What would your little world look like if you could build it inside a tiny box? In this hands on workshop, you get a little space to create a world of your own. It could be your dream bedroom, a cosy cafe, a rainy street, a place you have always wanted to visit, a childhood memory or simply a tiny version of a world you have imagined. Choose the colours, objects and little details that feel right to you and slowly watch your idea come to life. There is no fixed design to follow and no right or wrong way to make it. The fun is in deciding what belongs in your world and bringing all those little details together. It is a quiet, creative experience where you can take a break, make something personal and leave with a tiny world that is completely yours. All materials required for the workshop will be provided. No prior art or craft experience is required.

title: Coil pottery
description: There is something incredibly satisfying about creating a piece of pottery with nothing more than your hands and a block of clay. Discover the timeless art of Coil Pottery as you shape long coils of clay and slowly transform them into a beautiful handmade piece. Every layer adds character, making the process just as rewarding as the final creation. This workshop is all about slowing down, getting your hands dirty and enjoying the simple joy of making something from scratch. Whether you choose a bowl, vase, planter or an abstract piece, your creation will be completely unique. Our host will guide you through each step, from rolling and joining the clay to shaping and refining your design. No experience is needed, just bring your curiosity and creativity. What you can look forward to: Learn the traditional art of coil pottery. Create your own handmade ceramic piece. Explore simple pottery techniques in a beginner-friendly setting. Enjoy a relaxing and mindful creative experience. Meet like-minded people and spend quality time creating together. Take home a one-of-a-kind pottery piece made entirely by you. Perfect for date nights, weekend outings, solo experiences, friends, families and anyone looking to try something different. Every masterpiece begins with a single coil. Join us for an experience where creativity takes shape one layer at a time, and leave with a piece that is uniquely yours.

title: Naalayak
description: Hailing from Chandigarh, Naalayak is an indie-rock powerhouse led by frontman Sahil Samuel, celebrated across the country for blending the raw grit of rock with soulful Hindi-Urdu poetry. Over the last decade, they have carved out a fierce following through strictly original music and deeply personal anthems like Zakir, Baawra, and tracks from their album Marammat. Known for a voice that breaks, burns, and rises in the same breath, their lyrics cut straight to the bone, turning themes of heartbreak, chaos, and healing into unforgettable live moments. Paired with October’s electric nightlife atmosphere, the evening promises heavy guitar riffs, booming drums, and hundreds of voices screaming every word back at the stage. Whether you’re nursing a heartbreak, chasing an adrenaline rush, or just looking to lose your voice with friends over great food and drinks, this is the kind of raw, unfiltered indie night Dehradun talks about long after the last chord fades.
